description: A built-in agent that proposes improvements to this workspace's agents, workflows, and team. Every change waits for an owner's or admin's approval.
enable_hint: Choose the runtime Evolution runs on.
not_enabled_member: Evolution is not enabled. Ask a workspace owner or admin to enable it.
config_scope: Reads this workspace's issue comments and, with chat on, members' chats with agents, on the schedule below. Never reads run logs, comments in private projects, chats with private agents, or excluded projects and agents. Secrets and personal details are removed before reading.
chat_pending: Saving notifies every member before any chat is read.
output_project_hint: Analysis reports, condense reviews, and proposals Evolution creates from now on go into this project, so a Super Agent subscribed to it can follow them up. Existing issues stay where they are.
output_project_missing: The chosen project was deleted or you can't see it. New issues get no project. Choose another project or No project before saving.
output_project_archived: The chosen project is archived. New issues get no project until it is restored. Choose another project or No project before saving.
output_project_private: The chosen project is private. New issues get no project until it is public again. Choose another project or No project before saving.
notice_body: Evolution will read every member's chats with agents in this workspace, from now on. Each member gets an inbox notice that says what is read, what is not, how proposals refer to it, and that an owner or admin can turn it off here.

proposal.label: Proposal
proposal.apply_body: Writes this change to the {{field}} of {{target}}. The current version is kept, so the change can be rolled back.
proposal.rollback_body: Restores the {{field}} of {{target}} to what it was before version {{version}}.
